 BIGBANG 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR IN HONG KONG Concludes Successfully
 By PR Newswire
 November 18, 2026
 Resize 
 Small 
 Medium 
 Large 
 HONG KONG , Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On November 17, the four-day BIGBANG 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR IN HONG KONG , jointly organized by TME live and ELF ASIA, officially came to a close.
 BIGBANG 2026-2027 WORLD TOUR IN HONG KONG 
 As one of the most highly anticipated stops of the current world tour, the Hong Kong concerts not only delivered spectacular performances filled with sincerity and dedication, but also extended BIGBANG's 20th-anniversary fan support installations and photo spots to multiple locations across Hong Kong. These attractions were widely praised by media outlets and fans as "one of the most thoughtfully organized stops of the tour." During the concerts, V.I.P from around the world gathered at Hong Kong's iconic sports and entertainment landmark, Kai Tak Stadium at Kai Tak Sports Park. Hong Kong became the first city on this tour to host four shows, with all four performances sold out and a total attendance of over 150,000, making BIGBANG the first K-POP boy group to hold four consecutive concerts at Kai Tak Stadium.

 Supported by coordinated promotional efforts across TME and its platforms, including QQ Music, JOOX, and Kugou Music, fans both online and offline came together for this legendary musical celebration spanning two decades, immersing themselves in BIGBANG's phenomenal, high-caliber audiovisual performances.
 At the concerts, BIGBANG performed a series of era-defining hits, including "FANTASTIC BABY," "IF YOU," "Haru Haru," "LIE," and "BANG BANG BANG." As soon as the opening notes sounded, the entire stadium was instantly electrified.
 Advertisement 
 The iconic sea of yellow crown light sticks moved in rhythm with the music, while the voices of tens of thousands of fans singing along echoed throughout the venue, bringing back the cherished memories of a generation.
 When BIGBANG performed "BiiiG," their new single released in celebration of their 20th debut anniversary, both longtime and new fans were drawn into the group's very own "COSMOS" musical universe.
 Beyond the world-class stage design, lighting, and sound production, the concerts also featured specially created visual experiences.
 Over Victoria Harbour, a customized drone light show lit up the night sky. Together with large-scale themed installations throughout the venue, the show brought the tour's "COSMOS" concept to life.
 Advertisement 
 Fan support installations and photo spots across Hong Kong further enhanced the celebratory atmosphere. These included the BIGBANG 20th Anniversary Commemorative Space, Hong Kong-exclusive Crown Art Installation, citywide digital billboards and photo spots, interactive installations at Kai Tak Sports Park, and the BIGBANG 20th Anniversary Media Exhibition .
 Each location served as an immersive photo destination where fans could share their memories and emotions accumulated over the past two decades, bringing anticipation and excitement to new heights.
 Together, these experiences created a seamless connection between hearing BIGBANG's music and seeing the group in person, extending the concert experience far beyond the stage.
 TME also prepared a collection of exclusive Hong Kong concert souvenirs for fans attending the shows.
 Advertisement 
 The specially designed gifts included 20th-anniversary customized crown holographic cards, exclusive blind-box rings, exclusive keychain accessories, and customized card-style cameras , offering every V.I.P who made the journey a unique and unforgettable keepsake.
 The successful execution of the concerts was also made possible through the collective support of various partners.
 This stadium-scale concert experience was defined not only by the spectacular moments on stage, but also by the thoughtful attention to detail throughout the entire event. It became a meaningful musical and cultural gathering that connected fans from Hong Kong and around the world, combining nostalgia, emotion, and a premium concert experience.
 Through this grand, mutual celebration between BIGBANG and V.I.P, countless touching moments became treasured memories of the Hong Kong stop of the world tour.
 Advertisement 
 As twenty years have passed, BIGBANG on stage and their fans beneath the sea of yellow lights continue to resonate together within the same universe.

 Looking ahead, TME live hopes to continue joining hands with global music partners, alongside BIGBANG and V.I.P, to write the next chapter of this extraordinary musical universe. About BIGBANG 
 BIGBANG is a boy group launched by YG Entertainment in 2006.
 Since the release of their debut single "Bigbang," the group has grown into a top-tier global artist, producing numerous hit songs, including "LIE," "LAST FAREWELL," "Haru Haru," "FANTASTIC BABY," and "BANG BANG BANG."
 BIGBANG has dominated domestic and international music charts and swept major awards at numerous music ceremonies. Both as a group and as individual members, their boundless potential as musicians has earned widespread recognition.
 In 2022, they released the digital single "STILL LIFE," once again demonstrating their powerful influence in the global music market.
 Transcending the boundaries of K-pop, BIGBANG has become an iconic presence across live performances, fashion, and popular culture.
 To commemorate their 20th debut anniversary, the group announced a highly anticipated return to the stage at the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival in the United States, drawing an enthusiastic response from local audiences and once again demonstrating their extraordinary capabilities.
 In August this year, BIGBANG successfully launched a new world tour in Goyang, with plans to meet fans around the world.
 On August 19, the exact date of their 20th debut anniversary, BIGBANG released "BiiiG," their first new digital single in four years, receiving an enthusiastic response from fans worldwide.
 About TME live 
 TME live is a diversified entertainment business brand newly established by Tencent Music Entertainment Group (TME), a leading music entertainment services provider in China, with live performances at its core.
 Through two primary formats-offline concert organization and online live streaming, interactive experiences, and virtual performances-TME live aims to break down the boundaries between online and offline music performances.
 By leveraging multi-scenario and innovative performance formats, together with high-speed, ultra-high-definition digital audiovisual technologies, TME live is committed to building a comprehensive music entertainment ecosystem that seamlessly integrates online and offline live experiences.
